Frequently 
Asked Questions 

How is MDR different from traditional MSSP services? 

MSSPs focus on log collection and alerting. MDR goes further with 24/7 expert analysis, proactive threat hunting, AI-driven detection, guided and/or active response and resiliency guidance for posture improvement . Kudelski Security’s MDR is built on contextualized intelligence and high-touch analyst engagement, we don’t just escalate alerts, we help contain and eradicate threats before they disrupt your business . 

How does Kudelski Security MDR integrate with my existing tools and team? 

We don’t force rip-and-replace. Our FusionDetect™ platform integrates with leading EDR, SIEM, XDR, and cloud platforms (Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Splunk, Claroty, etc.). Our analysts extend your team with right-sized response workflows , so you maintain control while benefiting from our automation and AI-augmented expertise . 

What outcomes can I expect from Kudelski Security MDR? 

Faster detection and response : validated threats in minutes, containment <15 minutes MTTR for high-severity incidents. 
Noise reduction : up to 93% fewer alerts , so your team focuses only on what matters. 
Anticipation of breaches : exposure-driven hunts powered by CTEM insights. 
Continuous improvement : measurable maturity gains over time, not just one-off fixes. 

How does Kudelski Security MDR anticipate breaches before they happen? 

Our MDR is enriched with Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) . We identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and emerging attacker techniques most likely to be exploited in your environment. This proactive signal coverage allows us to launch hunts and implement controls before adversaries strike. 

What makes Kudelski Security MDR different from other providers? 

We combine: 
Cybersecurity-only focus with deep expertise across IT, OT/CPS, and emerging domains. 
A world-class Counter Adversary Unit (CAU™) for intelligence-driven hunts, threat research, detection engineering and proven Incident response and Digital Forensics capabilities. 
AI-augmented automation that personalizes hunts, validates alerts and augment our security analysts in their investigations, at scale. 
Global delivery with local expertise , providing predictable, outcome-driven security tailored to your business.
